title: ghunchou ke chatakne ki qabar auno mohammad
body:
ghunchou ke chatakne ki qabar auno mohammad
har phool me qushbu ka asar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas afaq shamso qamar auno mohammad
zainab ki duaou ka asar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
aajaenge qud bazm me phir shabbaro shabbir
ho mad'ha ka unwaan agar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
ban jayenge sajde ka nishaa'n lafz simat kar
tum likhhoge kagaz pe agar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hu sana unki mujhe is ka yaqee'n hai
denge mujhe lafzou ke gohar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
gar shehr shujaa'at ke bane hyder o jaffer
is shehre shujaa'at ke do dar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
do lakh ka hai waise sitam garou ka lashkar
kardenge magar zer o zabar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh me maadar hi ke tai kar ke chale the
bhar poor shujaa'at ka safar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
phir shaam ke lashkar ki sehar hi na thi mumkin
kardete wegha chal ke agar auno mohammad
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dusre se kehte the chup ke se sitamgar
bhago ke na ajaye idhar auno mohammad
